_intent: Human-reviewed usage-tag corrections. Global entries apply only when a judgment is invariant across every matching use; occurrence entries target one persisted lyric occurrence and take precedence.
_workflow: Add an entry with action=add or remove, tags from the fixed list, a reason, and reviewed_by. Run tool_6e_apply_usage_tag_overrides.py for each affected artist. Exact occurrence entries are applied after global entries.
